name: zinput_bind_group_list_get_group_command_count
description: zInput::BindGroupList_GetGroupCommandCount returns zero for a group with no command-id buffer, otherwise the group command count.
known_limits: tier S verification is accepted by the zinput_bindmap_small_helpers VC target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja shows group lookup, null commandIdsBegin returning zero, and pointer-distance count from commandIdsBegin to commandIdsEnd.
Native smoke verifies populated and null command-list cases through BindGroupList_GetGroupCommandCount.
tier_s_evidence: After recovering zInput_CommandIdVector as the embedded command-id vector owner, VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /MD /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison at 0x42a4b0 matches with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 4 relocation bytes and trimming 2 NOPs; Binary Ninja body is 30 bytes and the VC object symbol is 32 bytes.
